'''Dubeh''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fyodos]]. He was the son of [[Kalor (Fyodos)|Kalor]], [[Chief/Legends|chief]] of the [[Roh tribe]], and his wife, [[Alyak]]. He also had a brother, [[Meerak]].
